query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Pipedrive CRM records: find deals and contacts, update deal participants and primary contacts, log notes and activities, schedule follow-ups, inspect deal and organization custom fields, and bulk reclassify deals across pipeline stages based on contract timing data.
query_ground_truth.query: inspect Pipedrive custom fields for deals and organizations
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve and inspect custom field definitions for deals and organizations.

results.use_case: inspect Pipedrive custom fields for deals and organizations
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step]: Retrieve all deal-field definitions using PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS (export full schema); paginate via response.data.additional_data.pagination.start until more_items_in_collection=false.

[Required] [Next Step]: Build a mapping field.key → (name, field_type, options) and an option id→label lookup when options exist (treat field.key as the stable identifier for read/write and decoding).
[Optional (if options/metadata look incomplete or inconsistent)] [Next Step]: Fetch one field using PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL_FIELD (confirm field_type/options, then refresh mapping for that key).

[Optional (if validating how values appear on real records)] [Next Step]: Fetch a sample using PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL (or a small list via PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEALS) to confirm values live under field.key and how enum/set values are encoded.
[Required] [Fallback]: If PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS fails with DNS/host resolution or SSRF-guard-style blocking, correct the configured base host/URL and retry the same call.
known_pitfalls: [PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS] Field definitions may be nested at response.data.data (not directly at response.data); parsing the wrong level yields empty/incorrect mappings.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS] Pagination state is under response.data.additional_data.pagination (start/limit/more_items_in_collection); ignoring it can silently drop fields.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS] Large schema responses may appear truncated in previews; build mappings from the full returned payload, not a shortened preview.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_ALL_DEAL_FIELDS] DNS/host resolution (including SSRF-guard-like failures) usually indicates a misconfigured base host/domain; retries without configuration changes won’t help.
[PIPEDRIVE_GET_DEAL] Custom fields may store option IDs (including comma-separated multi-select “set” values) and many values can be null/missing; validate decoding on real records before hardcoding.
